findings: The preserved source exactly asks whether 17^400 - 19^100 is divisible by 10.
The answer directly proves 17^400 ≡ 1 (mod 10) using the period-4 last-digit cycle of 7 and 19^100 ≡ 1 (mod 10) using the period-2 cycle of 9.
The exact candidate Java compiles and independently matches BigInteger and Python modular oracles.
The answer correctly explains that divisibility of a difference depends on congruence modulo 10 and does not require expanding or comparing the full powers.
The generic binary modular exponentiation implementation is O(log exponent) and keeps intermediate values bounded under modulus 10.
No fabricated project experience is claimed.
